summary: The focused candidate does not require maintenance: the old harness can pass XML_PARSE_NO_XXE through its input option bytes.

assessment.necessity_reason: A finite input can set bit 23 in the four option bytes. The harness clears other option bits but leaves bit 23 set and passes the resulting value to its XML parsing operations.

before.requirement: Select XML_PARSE_NO_XXE to suppress external content loading.
before.reason: The before parser option enum does not define XML_PARSE_NO_XXE.

after.requirement: Pass XML_PARSE_NO_XXE when parsing XML to suppress external DTD and entity loading.
after.reason: The new option is bit 23. The parser option mask includes it, and the supplied external content guards test it. The old harness can set that bit through input and passes the resulting options to its parser calls.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser's option mask includes and retains bit 23.
The pull parser receives the harness options through xmlCtxtReadMemory.
The new bit guards external subset loading.
The new bit guards external parameter entity content loading.
The new bit guards parsing external general entities.
The new bit guards external parameter entity input creation.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The push parser also receives the selected options.
The reader also receives the selected options.
The option reader can obtain all four bytes from fuzzer input.

assessment.comparison_reason: The option is absent before the change and selectable by the same old harness afterward.
